recovery during leisure time is related to day level positive outcomes at work.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nonwork context has an important influence on employees' work attitudes and behavior.
the more employees are able to recover during their nonwork time, the more they are engaged at work, and the more they will be proactive.

recovery from work-related fatigue during nonwork time has positive effects on subsequent work engagement and work behavior.
